review_findings.summary: Concurrent release calls could double-close or race lease validation on one descriptor.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 85998630 serializes release and validation with one lease state lock; the deterministic two-thread regression proves exactly one close.

review_findings.summary: Concurrent callers publishing the same staged generation could report failure after another caller completed it.
review_findings.resolution: Commit 508929ca reconciles the exact current identity and makes same-candidate completion idempotent; a forced two-thread interleaving passes.

review_findings.summary: Pending cleanup keyed only by candidate could delete a replacement intent with a different expected CURRENT.
review_findings.resolution: Commit c9a2c97c binds the marker filename and cleanup target to both candidate and expected CURRENT; the final DeepSeek incremental review returned GATE PASS.

review_findings.summary: External review claimed a fresh lock file had no fencing-token bootstrap.
review_findings.resolution: Rejected as a false positive: _acquire_lock_descriptor writes b'0' when size is zero, and cold-root publish/read-lease tests pass on Windows.

review_findings.summary: External review claimed generation.py omitted uuid and os imports.
review_findings.resolution: Rejected as a false positive: both imports are present and every pending-publication test executes those paths successfully.

review_findings.summary: External review described a marker created after lease admission as a fencing bypass.
review_findings.resolution: Rejected after concurrency review: the second marker check is the lease admission linearization point; a marker created later sees an existing reader, which the approved plan explicitly permits to finish.

review_findings.summary: A conflict after CURRENT changed retains its pending marker and requires reconciliation.
review_findings.resolution: Accepted as intentional fail-closed policy; commit c9a2c97c wraps the raw release error in an explicit reconciliation conflict instead of silently clearing audit state.

review_findings.summary: Directory-entry fsync is not portable on Windows, leaving a power-loss durability advisory for the pending hard link.
review_findings.resolution: Bounded to the P2 T6 integration/power-loss gate; process-crash recovery and file-content fsync are proven in T2 without adding a Windows-specific handle framework to this slice.

review_findings.summary: Final incremental review noted old marker format and dot-delimited identity advisories.
review_findings.resolution: Not applicable to deployment: T2 has not published a real marker, and both IDs are strict lowercase SHA-256 values that cannot contain dots.
